title: TelemetryEvent
description: Normalized telemetry envelope for one observed span or event (NS-01). Raw telemetry lives outside the catalog graph. Missing values are null or the enumerated 'unknown', never 0 by default; numeric 0 is only ever a measured zero. Prompt and response bodies are never carried here; see payload_ref. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by Python validators in tests/contracts: validate_span_not_self_parent (span_id must differ from parent_span_id) and validate_canonical_id_grammar (canonical_agent_id must also pass the catalog canonical-ID grammar owned by schemas/catalog/v1).

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document, major 1 with additive minor revisions.

event_id.description: Source-assigned event identifier. Idempotency is by (source_id, event_id).

event_time.description: When the event happened at the source (RFC 3339 UTC).

ingestion_time.description: When the ingest edge accepted the event (RFC 3339 UTC). Stamped server-side; null on the producer wire before acceptance.

cloud.description: Azure cloud boundary the event belongs to. Government data is never bridged to Commercial.

domain_id.description: Owning domain identifier. Null when not yet attributed.

source_id.description: Connector or producer that emitted the event.

external_agent_id.description: Agent identifier as reported by the source system. Null when the source does not report one.

canonical_agent_id.description: Resolved canonical agent ID (cloud:customer:source:type:id). Null until resolution succeeds. Pattern mirrors the catalog grammar; cross-checked by validate_canonical_id_grammar.

request_id.description: Request or correlation identifier from the source. Null when absent.

trace_id.description: W3C/OpenTelemetry trace ID, 32 lowercase hex characters. Null when the source is not traced.

span_id.description: W3C/OpenTelemetry span ID, 16 lowercase hex characters. Null when the source is not traced.

parent_span_id.description: Parent span ID; null for a root span or when unknown. Must differ from span_id (validate_span_not_self_parent).

span_kind.description: What this span represents. delegation, tool_call, retry, error and cancellation are first-class so multi-agent call trees can be reconstructed.

retry_attempt.description: 1-based attempt number for retry spans. Null when not a retry or not reported.

provider.description: Model or service provider (for example azure_openai). Null when unknown.

model.description: Model name as reported. Null when unknown.

model_version.description: Model version as reported. Null when unknown.

environment.description: Deployment environment of the observed workload. 'sandbox' marks the isolated synthetic sandbox.

duration_ms.description: Span duration in integer milliseconds. Null when not measured; 0 only when measured as zero.

token_breakdown.description: Token counts. Null when the source reports no token usage at all.

data_source_refs.description: Data sources touched by this span. Null when unknown; an empty array means observed to touch none.

classification.description: Data classification label applied to the event (for example cui). Null when unclassified or unknown.

sampling.description: Sampling metadata. Null when the source does not report sampling.

payload_ref.description: Optional pointer to a separately stored, redacted prompt/response payload. Bodies are off by default (NS-01).

canonical_id.description: cloud:customer:source:type:id; lowercase [a-z0-9._-] segments, id may also contain / and =.

token_breakdown.title: TokenBreakdown
token_breakdown.description: Token counts for one model interaction. Each count is nullable and defaults to null: null means not reported, 0 means a measured zero. Also referenced by cost/v1/cost-record.schema.json.

cached.description: Input tokens served from a provider prompt cache.

reasoning.description: Reasoning tokens reported separately by the provider.

data_source_ref.title: DataSourceRef
data_source_ref.description: Reference to a grounding source or data asset touched by the span.

ref.description: Canonical ID when resolved, otherwise the source-reported identifier.

rate.description: Fraction of events retained, in [0, 1]; 1 means unsampled. Null when unknown.

reason.description: Why this event was sampled or kept (for example error_kept). Null when not reported.

payload_ref.title: PayloadRef
payload_ref.description: Pointer to a stored payload; never the payload itself. The pointer is opaque and is never fetched by schema validation.

pointer.description: Opaque storage pointer (blob path or archive key).

classification.description: Classification label of the stored payload. Null when unknown.

redaction_state.description: Redaction status of the stored payload.
